descriptionChirho: Fine linen or byssus, a high-quality textile used in priestly garments and tabernacle furnishings. All translations converge: Spanish 'lino/lino fino' (linen/fine linen), Arabic 'كَتّانٍ/بُوصًا' (linen/byssus), Hindi 'सन/बारीक कपड़ा' (flax/fine cloth), Korean '고운 베/세마포' (fine cloth/fine linen), Swahili 'kitani/kitani safi' (linen/fine linen). The split is purely grammatical—conjunctive 'and fine linen' versus bare noun or prepositional 'in fine linen'—with no semantic distinction.
